items.description: Redesign foundation (DS-01): implement the "Ferro & Brasa" design system from .planning/design/ferro-brasa/ (read README.md, ficha-tokens.css and Ficha.dc.html). Replace the :root and .dark token blocks in app/globals.css with ficha-tokens.css values (keep shadcn variable names), map the extras in @theme inline (--color-vitality-notavel/ferido/grave/condenado/incapacitado/coma/track, --color-berkana, --color-berkana-foreground, --color-berkana-track, --color-success, --color-warning, --color-overlay, --font-numeric, shadow tokens) and add the ficha-pulse/ficha-spin keyframes; load Spectral, Barlow, Barlow Semi Condensed and JetBrains Mono through next/font/google in app/layout.tsx instead of the CSS @import and replace Geist; add a next-themes ThemeProvider (attribute class, default dark) and a small theme toggle reachable from the characters list header; restyle the inline edit primitives in components/ui/editable-field.tsx and editable-scaling-field.tsx to the design states (read-only plain text, idle dashed border 44px min height, editing ring, saving spinner, saved check, error border with cloud-off icon and "Não salvou · tentar de novo") without changing their save logic or props; add small shared presentational pieces used by later items (section card with the 7px diamond title marker, numeric display with font-numeric + tabular-nums, stat tile, bottom sheet wrapper built on components/ui/sheet.tsx side=bottom); restyle the sonner Toaster to the design toast look. No business logic changes; derived numbers unchanged

Redesign list, create and page states (DS-02): restyle app/characters/page.tsx, app/create/page.tsx and the loading / not-found / network-error states of app/character/[id]/page.tsx to match Ficha.dc.html screens lista, vazia, criar, carregando (skeleton with ficha-pulse), naoEncontrado, erroRede and the excluir alert dialog ("Excluir <nome>?" with Cancelar/Excluir), mobile-first at 390px and the wide desktop layout; keep search, pagination, create, delete and navigation behavior and the existing hooks exactly as they are

Redesign sheet shell and quick actions (DS-03): restyle app/character/[id]/page.tsx header and components/forms/character-layout.tsx to the design ficha shell (back button, serif name, "jogador · classe · Nv N" subtitle, refresh button, 4 underline tabs Básicos/Perícias/Magias/Notas with long labels on wide screens, "Modo edição · as alterações são salvas sozinhas" banner when unlocked, multi-column card flow with column-width 340px); rebuild components/character/quick-actions-bar.tsx as the design bottom bar (vitality button with stage icon/color/short label, Berkana current/max button, Armas, Perícias, Atributos, and the lock toggle Bloqueado/Desbloqueado driving the existing isEditMode) and replace the current quick-action dialogs and the skills/attributes modals with design bottom sheets (vit: amount input + 4 chips + preview + Dano/Cura + restore; berk: amount + chips + Gastar/Recuperar + restore; arma: weapon damage grid; atributos: 3-column totals; pericias: in-use skills with totals). Every value and every write must go through the existing calculation functions, mutation hooks and current damage/heal/spend semantics; derived numbers must stay identical; conflict and error toasts use the design toast style

Redesign Básicos tab (DS-04): restyle components/character/basic-info/*.tsx to the design basicos screen: Vitalidade card (stage badge with icon + position, big current/max number, 6-segment bar, Dano/Cura buttons opening the vit sheet from DS-03, per-stage rows with current marker), Berkana card (state label, big number, bar, Gastar/Recuperar opening the berk sheet, bonus), Armas (name, level badge, 5-cell damage grid with highlighted critical), Atributos (totals grid + collapsible distribution table), Experiência e Nível (level box, XP progress bar, "Faltam N XP para o nível N+1"), Armadura (name, description, current/total bar), Informações Básicas (2-column labeled inline fields), Linguagens (toggle chips with icon + "Outra" for custom languages). Keep all fields editable exactly as today through the existing EditableField components and mutation; numbers from lib/calculations only

Redesign Perícias & Kit tab (DS-05): rebuild components/character/skills-kit-tab.tsx to the design pericias screen and split it into components/character/skills-kit/ cards (each file under ~300 lines): skill points summary (Disponíveis/Gastos/Restantes with the remaining color), "Em uso / Todas" segmented filter, skills grouped by category with expandable rows showing distributed+bonus detail, total, and minus/plus steppers for distributed and bonus when unlocked; Finanças tiles; Kit de Aventureiro with custom items first, add item, and collapsible "Itens padrão · N". Keep the current skill-point pool, totals and persisted keys exactly as today (do not fix the known SKILLS key mismatch or pool question here); writes through the existing mutation

Redesign Magias & Talentos tab (DS-06): restyle components/character/spells-talents/*.tsx and spells-talents-tab.tsx to the design magias screen: Magias/Talentos segmented toggle, search field, "Nova" button when unlocked, horizontal level filter chips, cards grouped by level, collapsible rows (name, type/sub line, Berkana cost badge, "1× ao dia" badge for talents), expanded body with damage highlight, 2-column stats, description with preserved line breaks, and Editar/Excluir when unlocked. Keep the existing create/edit/delete dialogs, the EditableScalingField level scaling and all persisted fields unchanged

Redesign Anotações tab (DS-07): restyle components/character/notes-tab.tsx and components/character/notes/*.tsx to the design anotacoes screen: header with count, Ordenar/Concluir toggle and new-note button when writable, search field, collapsed note cards with serif title and one-line preview, expand to show formatted content and Editar/Excluir, reorder mode with grip icon and up/down 44px arrow buttons (using the existing moveNote), corrupted-notes alert with "Copiar texto original" (clipboard of the raw notes string) and legacy-notes alert with "Migrar anotações" wired to the existing one-time migration. Keep lib/notes.ts guarantees, the escape-then-format renderer from lib/notes-format.ts (never render unescaped HTML) and existing tests passing. Final gate for the whole batch: npx tsc --noEmit, bun run lint, bun test and bun run build all pass
